meta.google_calendar_settings: English (US), 24h, week starts Monday, secondary time zone Mexico City, modern color set, responsive density
meta.note: Every null must be filled from a real measurement (docs/04-fidelidad-visual.md). scripts/check-tokens.mjs fails if CSS uses a null token.

font.family_body: "Google Sans Text", "Google Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font.effective_family_note: gm3-light.json roles: body/sidebar/mini calendar/day names use Google Sans Text; the topbar title, month title and day numbers use Google Sans; Today/Week buttons use Google Sans Flex; icons use Google Material Icons.
font.family_topbar: "Google Sans Text", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font.family_button: "Google Sans Flex", "Google Sans Text", "Google Sans", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

event_palette.note: Modern UI palette by colorId, verified in docs/research/google-calendar-api.md section 8. Foreground and hover tones must be measured in component 10.
event_palette.source: measurements/palette.json (chip background and title colour per colorId, light and dark)

color.body_text_note: body_text copied from measurements/gm3-light.json and gm3-dark.json roles.body.color (Google leaves body color black in both themes; every visible text sets its own color)

calendar_palette.source: measurements/palette.json (fixture calendar colorId 1..24 cycled through calendarList.patch; classic = API backgroundColor)
calendar_palette._note: The API reports the classic hex; the UI paints the measured tone.

layout.chip_width_factor_note: Derived from measurements/hour_grid-light.json: Overlap A 116.28px / column 136.80px × 2 columns = 1.70; Triple A 77.52px / 136.80px × 3 = 1.70. A chip in column i of n spans min(1.7/n, 1 − i/n) of the column width; left = i/n.
layout.chip_height_gap_note: measurements/hour_grid-light.json: Fifteen 13px, Thirty 28px, Forty-five 43px, Sixty 58px, Ninety 88px = minutes − 2px at 60px per hour.
layout.week_initial_scroll_note: Probed on calendar.google.com (week view, 1440×900, Date shifted to 08:30, 10:00, 13:00, 15:30): the grid opens at scrollTop 420px (07:00) whenever the now line falls inside the visible window; at 19:29 (now line at 1169px, outside the window) it opened at the bottom (753px) and at 00:30 at 0px, which matches scrollTop = clamp(nowY − week_scroll_now_margin).
layout.main_gap_note: measurements/hour_grid-light.json rootRect [256,64,1168,820] inside a 1440×900 viewport: 16px free on the right and at the bottom.
layout.week_scroll_now_margin_note: See week_initial_scroll_note: the only out-of-window observations were clamped, so 90px is the smallest margin consistent with them (08:30: 510 − 420) and is applied only when the now line is outside the window.
layout.allday_row_min_height_note: not measured: the reference week has all-day events in every dump (allday_row.md)
layout.popup_anchor_note: Probed on calendar.google.com (2026-09-14, 1440×900) by clicking ten chips and seven empty slots. Both the event popup and the quick-create dialog anchor to the day COLUMN of the chip/slot: at the right when it fits, left edge = column right − 4px (Sixty: column right 525.1 → popup 521); otherwise at the left, right edge = column left − 10px (Weekend: 1124.3 → 1115; quick create in Thursday: 824.7 → 305; in Tuesday: 525.1 → 6). Vertically the event popup is centred in the viewport whatever the chip (243px → 328.5; 449 → 225.5; 405 → 247.5; 325 → 287.5). The quick-create dialog is centred too (193.5 for 513px) unless the clicked slot starts below the centred dialog: then its bottom edge sits 1px above the slot top (slot at 736 → 222; at 796 → 283).
layout.popup_gap_note: See popup_anchor_note: 8px between the chip and the popup, popup top 48px above the chip top.

week.line_after_note: getComputedStyle(cell, "::after") on calendar.google.com (2026-09-14): content "", position absolute, left/right 0, height 0, margin-top -1px, z-index 3, border-bottom 1px solid rgb(221, 227, 234) (same as lines.borderTop); the line of hour k lies at 60k px from the top of the row.
week.body_inner_before_note: getComputedStyle(bodyInner, "::before"): the shadow under the header row, absolute at top 0 inside .week-body (position relative), width 100% minus the 16px scrollbar gutter on the right.
week.fades_note: getComputedStyle(gutter, "::before") and (bodyInner, "::after") on calendar.google.com, light and with prefers-color-scheme: dark emulated (2026-09-14): 2px-high fades over the header shadow at both ends, absolute at top 0, z-index 507.
